claim: Joe Biden said “You know, we have to come together. That’s why I’m running. I’m running as a proud Democrat for the Senate. So vote! Vote!”
justification: The claim states that Joe Biden made the statement on December 10, 2020, but high-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based fact-check (e.g., confidence 0.95) confirms the quote was made on October 12, 2020, at a campaign rally. Additionally, high-confidence knowledge-only evidence (confidence 0.95) indicates that Biden was not running for Senate in 2020 and was President-elect by December 10, 2020, explicitly refuting the claim's date and context.
